_comment: S2 gate configuration (@micro/ds batch 1). Every list here is the explicit, extensible form of a rule that the brief states in prose. Sources: BRIEF 0.7/0.8/23.18/24.2/24.3, plan section 2/8. Extend here, never inside a gate script.
_banned_deps_note: deps+devDeps entries are matched exactly; @phosphor-icons/core is allowed only as the S1 generation devDependency, never as a source import (D5) — ds-banned flags it in ds/src as an import, ds-consumer checks where it lives.
_props_note: banned_props_types applies to component prop interfaces (*.types.ts and interface/type blocks in component .tsx) — BRIEF 23.18: no aliases (color for tone, type for variant) and no free design-value props. HTML attribute pass-through on real elements (e.g. type="button") is not a component prop. flow/debt: Money's signed forms (BRIEF 8: داخل/خارج/تحويل، لك/عليك) — flow renamed from direction per BRIEF-ADDENDUM-1.6 و-1 item 31; direction REMAINS the Metric/HeroSurface diff-line node (BRIEF 23.8). placeholder: TextField format hint (23.24(10)). optional: TextField's optional-field mark (lesson rule 67: only optional fields carry «اختياري» after the label). || batch-2 3.3 (م-خ1..م-خ3): items/min/max/step/weekStart/mode/useSystemKeyboard — mode NOT kind (owner decision 1.3; kind stays banned in JSX).

copy._limits_note: placeholder/screen-reader have no word-count ceiling in plan 8-و (the plan sets none for them); they are still checked for banned phrases and exclamation marks.

brief_verbatim_overrides.saveState.draft: BRIEF 11 [مؤكد] mandates the badge text «مسودة · لم تُحفظ» verbatim (3 words); plan 8-و preamble: «إن تعارض أي حد مع الموجز، الموجز يغلب». Word-count ceiling waived for this key only; banned-phrase/lexicon checks still apply.
brief_verbatim_overrides.avail.unavailable: BATCH2-SPECS-ADDENDUM §2.5 table verbatim «غير متوفر مؤقتاً» (owner-closed question 6); the badge word ceiling yields to the addendum as it does for saveState.draft
brief_verbatim_overrides.report.offTopic: BATCH2-SPECS-ADDENDUM §2.8 verbatim report reason «خارج النطاق المسموح» (owner-closed question 9)
brief_verbatim_overrides.report.spam: BATCH2-SPECS-ADDENDUM §2.8 verbatim report reason «إعلان مزعج» (owner-closed question 9); the 24.3 lexicon bans «إعلان» as the name of a MARKET LISTING — the report taxonomy is a different concept and the addendum outranks BRIEF 24
brief_verbatim_overrides.report.contact: BATCH2-SPECS-ADDENDUM §2.8 verbatim report reason «مشكلة في التواصل» (owner-closed question 9)

copy._lexicon_note: BRIEF 24.3 'لا تُستخدم' column, matched as whole words (tokens) so Arabic prefixes/suffixes don't false-positive. The positive 'full closed vocabulary' check (every word must appear in the lexicon) is not implementable from the brief — the 24.3 table maps only 10 concepts — and stays a reviewer/ناقد duty; documented in the S2 report.
copy._banned_prefixes_note: lesson rules 64 and 42 (unit 15): no «عن…/معنى…/اقرأ…» links anywhere, and «+» opens a creation only — the dictionary carries creation verbs as words, never a leading «+» (the batch-2 QuantityStepper's plus is an icon glyph, not dictionary text).

_css_note: Manually listed CSS syntax that the target floor (iOS 16.4 / Chrome 116 / Samsung 23) cannot parse. :has() is NOT here — it is supported since Chrome 105 / Safari 15.4. The authoritative per-decision check stays stylelint-no-unsupported-browser-features (runs in ds lint), this list is the belt for at-rules/functions stylelint cannot see.
_lowend_note: The plan's only hard size numbers are K12 (each component ≤ 8KB gzip) and the woff2 budget (65KB, task). index.js/styles.css have no plan number, so the budget = measured S1 baseline with margin (16KB / 8KB gzip) + the K12 per-component allowance for every built component. Adjust here only with a leader decision.

banned_code_patterns._note: unit 15 static bans: rule 11 (the browser's native date field) and rule 55 (currency-symbol icons; the money icons are the named 23.23 set). Matched in the ds source with comments stripped, like ds-raw-values.

lesson rule 55: currency-symbol icons are banned
